articles.title: Latvia targets tokenization rules in 2027 with commercial property in focus
articles.snippet: Economics Minister Viktors Valainis says rules could arrive in the first half of next year, but an overdue assessment remains unfinished and no sovereign-bond issuance was identified.

articles.title: Strategy, Strive face balancing act between bitcoin buying and preferred stock dividends
articles.snippet: The securities have financed purchases of nearly 136,000 bitcoin, opening a funding channel that analysts expect to complement the larger ETF market.

articles.title: Argentina drops criminal probe into President Milei over crashed memecoin LIBRA
articles.snippet: The judge found that Milei's promotion of LIBRA did not constitute fraud, despite the attention his support drew to the token.

articles.title: Bitcoin Core changes security rules as AI makes finding code bugs dangerously easy
articles.snippet: Developers merged a policy change that ends the months-long embargo for flaws a chatbot could rediscover, after a summer in which AI found hundreds of bitcoin bugs before the humans did.

articles.title: Ethereum delays Glamsterdam test after security devs flag risk to existing contracts
articles.snippet: Developers canceled Monday's Hoodi activation after researchers showed how new gas rules could let smart contracts permanently record failed operations.
